mechanism: Hydrocortisone (glucocorticoid) promotes sodium retention and potassium excretion, opposing eplerenone's mineralocorticoid receptor antagonism, reducing eplerenone efficacy and increasing hyperkalemia risk.
action: Monitor serum potassium and renal function closely; adjust eplerenone dose if needed; consider alternative corticosteroid or dosage reduction of hydrocortisone if clinically feasible.
